title: Mute, bypass, reroutes and groups: what the server really gets

questions.q: You bypass an ImageBlur in the middle of a chain. What does the server receive?
options: A graph with no blur, where the next node is wired to whatever fed the blur
The blur node marked with mode 4
The blur node with its radius set to 0
A graph with a gap and an error
questions.answer: A graph with no blur, where the next node is wired to whatever fed the blur
questions.why: The API format has no mode field. The editor follows the wire through the bypassed node and writes the result.

questions.q: You mute the same ImageBlur. What happens when you queue?
options: Validation fails: the next node is missing its required input
The chain runs without the blur
The node runs but its output is ignored
The whole queue stops permanently
questions.answer: Validation fails: the next node is missing its required input
questions.why: A muted node gives no output, so the wire is dropped and required_input_missing follows, unless that input was optional.

questions.q: You bypass a VAEDecode, whose inputs are LATENT and VAE and whose output is IMAGE. What does the PreviewImage after it get?
options: Nothing, because no input of VAEDecode has type IMAGE
The latent, as if it were an image
The VAE
A blank image
questions.answer: Nothing, because no input of VAEDecode has type IMAGE
questions.why: Bypass only passes something through when the types allow it. Here none fits, so the wire is dropped.

questions.q: What does a Reroute dot add to the graph the server sees?
options: Nothing: the wire goes straight from source to target
One extra node that copies the value
A short delay
A cached copy of the value
questions.answer: Nothing: the wire goes straight from source to target
questions.why: Reroute is a virtual node in the editor. Sent by hand to the server it gives missing_node_type, because the server has no such class.

questions.q: A group is set to Bypass Group Nodes. What did that actually do?
options: It set the mode of each node inside, and the group itself is not in the API graph
It told the server to skip a region of the canvas
It deleted the nodes
It turned the group into a subgraph
questions.answer: It set the mode of each node inside, and the group itself is not in the API graph
questions.why: A group is a rectangle in the save format. Its menu changes the modes of the nodes in it.
